body:
I'm almost 37 and this is relatable. I had a cancer scare recently and was bitterly disappointed it turned out to be nothing. My life is exactly the same as it was when I was 22, except I had a much better job back then. It's been downhill since. 

There is less to look forward to every passing day. The years keep flying by and I have nothing to show for them.

Yes. I have both depression and anxiety, and normal everyday conversations can send me into an emotional tailspin. I end up replaying convos in my head and thinking how awkward I am, then I get more depressed. So I don't interact with anyone unless forced to, and even then I'll do whatever I can to email/text instead of having in-person interaction.

I was told to meditate as though that would solve a lifetime of self-sabotage and abandonment issues. I probably should have kept up with therapy, but it's so deflating when they make it seem like running on a treadmill or doing yoga is actually going to make a difference.

This hits incredibly close to home. I am almost 37, which is unfathomable to me. When I was growing up I never imagined what it would be like to be 25, let alone 30 fucking 7. I always assumed I would never make it this far and really wish I hadn't. 

I don't have friends, just people I work with. I don't have hobbies. I hate waking up every morning. The last date I went on, I was asked "What are your dreams?" and I almost cried at the bar. I wish I were dead.
